plugin.name: Holy Templar Magic
plugin.description: Enderal patch for Kittytail's Holy Templar Magic (Lightpower.esl). Repoints its Dawnguard visual effects onto Enderal's own Light Magic effects, rescales mana costs and tome prices onto Enderal's scale, makes Consecrate Dead's heal pay Arcane Fever, and sells all six tomes at Halda Stronghand's shop in the Sun Temple. Requires Holy Templar Magic and SPID. Load this patch after Lightpower.esl.

plugin.name: Ancient Blood Magic II
plugin.description: Enderal patch for Kittytail's Ancient Blood Magic II (AncientBloodII.esl). Restores its Dawnguard-based effects - the vampire bat swarms, the drain impacts, the Stone Gargoyle's abilities and the Eternal Legion's dragonbone gear - by copying those records into the patch (Enderal ships the meshes and sounds; only the records were missing). Rescales mana costs and tome prices onto Enderal's scale and sells all fourteen tomes through the Fence in the Undercity barracks. The two boss fights live in Dawnguard locations Enderal does not have and are not reachable. Requires Ancient Blood Magic II. Load this patch after AncientBloodII.esl.
